describe.description: The image shows a single quadrupedal animal in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background, with the overall body shape, dense shaggy fur, and head of a brown bear. The fur is medium to dark brown, longer and shaggier on the legs and underside, with a lighter tan muzzle. From the dorsal surface of the neck, back, and side protrude several large, glossy, dark reddish-brown convex oval structures resembling beetle wing covers, and two large translucent membranous wings with dark brown veining extend laterally from the torso. The posterior ends in a long, segmented, armored tail that curves downward, and the lateral flank shows rows of narrow dark slit-like openings in the fur. The animal stands on four paws with visible claws.

describe.description: A stocky four-legged creature with the furry body, head, and limbs of a brown bear combined with beetle features. The body is covered in dense shaggy brown fur and stands on four thick bear legs with clawed paws. The head is bear-like with a tan muzzle, dark nose, and small rounded ears. Glossy dark reddish-brown beetle elytra are set into the fur over the shoulders and sides, with large translucent tan membranous wings with brown veining extending outward from the shoulder area. Rows of dark oval slit-like openings are visible in the fur on the flank and hindquarter. A long segmented glossy dark insect-like tail with a forked tip extends from the rear.
